in_sanskrit.name: दhanुस
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Danis is derived from the Sanskrit word धनुस् (dhanus) which means bow or weapon. This name is likely to be given to a baby boy, symbolizing strength, power, and protection.

in_hindi.name: दानिस
in_hindi.meaning: दानिस (dānis) - दhanुस् (dhanus) + स (s) - suffix meaning 'one who possesses'
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Danis in Hindi is formed by adding the suffix स (s) to the Sanskrit word धनुस् (dhanus), meaning bow or weapon. The suffix स (s) in Hindi means 'one who possesses'. Therefore, the name Danis in Hindi can be translated to 'one who possesses a bow or weapon'.

in_tamil.name: தனிச்சி
in_tamil.meaning: தனிச்சி (taṉicci) - தனி (taṉi) + ச்சி (cci) - தனி (taṉi) meaning 'self' + suffix ச்சி (cci) meaning 'one who has'
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Danis in Tamil is formed by adding the suffix ச்சி (cci) to the Tamil word தனி (taṉi) which means self. The suffix ச்சி (cci) in Tamil means 'one who has'. Therefore, the name Danis in Tamil can be translated to 'one who has a self or possesses himself'.

in_telugu.name: దనిశ్
in_telugu.meaning: దనిశ్ (daniś) - దని (dani) + శ్ (ś) - suffix meaning 'one who possesses'
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Danis in Telugu is formed by adding the suffix శ్ (ś) to the Telugu word దని (dani), meaning self or I. The suffix శ్ (ś) in Telugu means 'one who possesses'. Therefore, the name Danis in Telugu can be translated to 'one who possesses himself or has a self'
